tonight.headline: Tuten missed Thursday — and Rice is still his only cover
body: Bad news first: Tuten went from limited Wednesday to did-not-practise Thursday (Jaguars report, Giants.com 19 Nov; NBC 21:16Z). Your bench still has no back who plays after noon — Marks is out tonight, Jacobs out and on bye — so the decision cannot wait for Sunday's 13:55 inactives. The rule tightens: if Friday's report lists him doubtful or out, OR he misses Friday's practice too, move Gordon to RB and start Rice in FLEX before 12:00.

Taylor opens your week tonight at 19:15 in Houston with no designation; the Colts plan to use Taylor and McGowan heavily (The Athletic via Yahoo 19 Nov) and Houston are 87% favourites in ESPN's Playbook. ESPN projects 128.1 to 124.8 and gives you 52%. The lineup as set is the projection lineup.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Lawrence (18.6), Parker Washington (15.3) and Skattebo (14.5) all play Jacksonville–New York at 15:25 — the same game as your Tuten and Likely (league file). And Hutchinson (10.7) inherits Harrison Jr.'s targets tonight with Harrison ruled out (SI Texans).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten inactive at 13:55 with Rice already locked — 17.0 projected points to zero. After Thursday's DNP, Friday's practice is the trigger.

case.label: The gap
case.body: Your bench is Rice (KC, 12:00), Odunze (CHI, 12:00), Golden (bye), Jacobs (out, bye) and Marks (out tonight — SI Texans final report). Tuten's inactives come at 13:55 — after every possible replacement has locked.

case.label: What changed today
case.body: Limited Wednesday, DID NOT PRACTISE Thursday with the ankle/foot (Jaguars report, Giants.com 19 Nov; CBS/RotoWire 16:24 ET, 'may be routine maintenance'). Last week he sat two practices and took 29 touches, so a Thursday DNP alone is not a ruling — but this morning's brief named a Thursday DNP as the thing that would change the call, and it did.

case.label: The rule
case.body: Friday's final Jaguars report: OUT or DOUBTFUL, or no practice Friday → before 12:00 Sunday move Ollie Gordon II to RB and start Rashee Rice (12.8; full practice Wednesday and Thursday — Chiefs.com) in FLEX. QUESTIONABLE after a limited or full Friday → start Tuten (17.0). A Sunday-morning report before 12:00 that he is not expected to play also triggers the move.

case.label: Why not insure on the wire
case.body: A Sunday-night back (Kaelon Black, Aaron Jones, Jordan Mason — free agents) would be live at 13:55, but the only cheap seat is Marks', whose add-thesis has not tripped, and it locks when Houston kick off tonight at 19:15. Jacobs' seat is a back with a 'realistic chance' for 25 Nov (CBS/Rapoport 17 Nov). Not recommended; your call if you disagree.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: You keep Tuten on a questionable tag after a limited Friday and he is inactive (zero from the slot), or you bench him under this rule and he plays and outscores Rice (archive).
